subject: Insurance
title: Whole Life: Insurance Plus Savings
description: A short lesson to help you apply Whole Life: Insurance Plus Savings.

hook.text: Whole life insurance covers you forever and builds cash value.

buildup.text: Unlike term, whole life never expires. As long as you pay premiums, the payout is guaranteed whenever you die.

discovery.text: The cash value grows tax-deferred. You can borrow against it or surrender the policy and take the cash.

twist.text: Whole life costs 5-15 times more than term.

climax.text: Whole life is a debate: guaranteed coverage for life, or overpriced bundle? The answer depends on your wealth and goals.

punchline.text: Coverage forever, cash value inside. Whole life costs 10x more than term.

quiz.question: How does whole life differ from term life?
options: It covers you forever and builds cash value
